versions.changelog:
- Initial release of verity-guard: an independent, fail-closed verification service for reviewing risky actions, fact-checking claims, screening for prompt injection, and redacting sensitive information.
- Supports four main checks: check (allow/review/block actions), verify (fact-check claims), injection (scan text for threats), and redact (flag PII/secrets).
- Every paid verdict is Ed25519-signed and independently re-verifiable.
- Pay-per-call model using USDC on Base; no subscription or API key required.
- Advises users on irreversible or high-risk actions with actionable, signed decisions (allow, review, block), including rationale and safer alternatives. 
- Includes free receipt verification and robust guidance for safe usage and setup.
